title: Software engineers' new job isn't writing code — it's designing the boundaries AI agents can't break
snippet: If you look at the commit histories of modern data platforms, something profound has shifted over the last two years. The friction of writing syntax has collapsed. With Cursor, Claude Code, and agentic workflows now living inside our Docker containers and IDEs, generating the first implementation of a distributed streaming pipeline or a complex API integration is no longer the central bottleneck. Agents can navigate repositories, write test coverage, inspect stack traces, and propose refactors.

title: Tesla driver who died when his car stopped on highway was using FSD/Autopilot
snippet: A 43-year-old man died when his Tesla Model 3, stopped in a live lane of Interstate 4, was rear-ended by a semi. Florida troopers said they couldn’t explain why the car was stopped in the middle of the highway. Tesla’s own data can explain it, the car’s driver-assist system was engaged, but the company has sealed it. This is part of an ongoing Electrek series where we match unexplained fatal crashes with Tesla’s own redacted data on ADAS crashes. more…
